The structure of SrAg₂P₂O₇ is monoclinic, space group C2/c (No. 15), with a unit cell containing 24 atoms across five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag centers coordinated by three O neighbors, P centers by five O neighbors, and Sr centers by nine O neighbors, while O centers have 3- to 7-fold geometric coordination. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner- and edge-sharing between P and Sr coordination polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between P polyhedra.
